source_fact.detail: 'Forward Voltage/Segment or DP VF - 2.05 2.5 V IF = 20 mA' (Red, Device Series HDSP-55XX)
source_fact.scope: Broadcom HDSP-5523; HDSP-55xx red AlInGaP series; per segment or DP; IF = 20 mA, TA = 25 C

limits: One segment at the source per-segment forward test current through its own common, other segments idle, against the sourced per-segment maximum VF at 25 C. It does not validate multiplexing, several lit segments, common-pin heating, optics or reverse operation.
